_comment: Model Guide data for DocAnalyser. Curated by developer, pulled by app on startup. Each model carries a 'tier' field: 'premium' (most capable), 'balanced' (everyday workhorse), or 'fast' (fast & cheap). Providers may have fewer than three tiers filled where no suitable model exists.

OpenAI (ChatGPT)._description: OpenAI offers a range of models balancing speed, capability and cost.

gpt-5.2.name: gpt-5.2
gpt-5.2.best_for: Deep analysis of transcripts, nuanced summarisation, complex reasoning tasks

gpt-5.1.name: gpt-5.1
gpt-5.1.best_for: Everyday document analysis and summarisation — a capable all-rounder

gpt-5-mini.name: gpt-5-mini
gpt-5-mini.best_for: Batch processing across many documents, quick summaries, cost-sensitive runs

Anthropic (Claude)._description: Anthropic's Claude models excel at nuanced writing and analysis.

claude-opus-4-7.name: claude-opus-4-7
claude-opus-4-7.best_for: Deep analysis of transcripts, nuanced interview summarisation, complex reasoning across long documents

claude-sonnet-4-6.name: claude-sonnet-4-6
claude-sonnet-4-6.best_for: Everyday document analysis and summarisation — the right choice for most oral history work

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.name: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.best_for: Batch processing across many documents, quick summaries, cost-sensitive runs

Google (Gemini)._description: Google's Gemini models offer a generous free tier.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.name: gemini-3.1-pro-preview
gemini-3.1-pro-preview.best_for: Deep analysis of transcripts and long documents (preview release — cutting edge)

gemini-2.5-flash.name: gemini-2.5-flash
gemini-2.5-flash.best_for: Everyday document analysis on the generous free tier

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.name: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
gemini-2.5-flash-lite.best_for: Fastest Gemini option on the free tier — ideal for batch runs and quick summaries

xAI (Grok)._description: xAI's Grok models from Elon Musk's AI company.

DeepSeek._description: DeepSeek offers excellent quality at very low cost. V4 models support a 1M-token context window.

deepseek-v4-pro.name: deepseek-v4-pro
deepseek-v4-pro.best_for: Frontier-tier reasoning and analysis with 1M-token context — exceptional value at this quality

deepseek-v4-flash.name: deepseek-v4-flash
deepseek-v4-flash.best_for: Everyday document analysis with 1M-token context — fast and excellent value

Moonshot (Kimi)._description: Kimi by Moonshot AI (Beijing). K3 is an open-weight multimodal model with a 1M-token context window — long interviews fit in a single pass. Privacy terms are not recorded in DocAnalyser's endpoint-disclosure table; check Moonshot's own policy before sending identifiable material.

kimi-k3.name: kimi-k3
kimi-k3.best_for: Whole-interview analysis in one pass (1M-token context); also handles images for OCR

kimi-k2.6.name: kimi-k2.6
kimi-k2.6.best_for: Everyday summarising and analysis at about a third of K3's price — text only

LM Studio (Local)._description:
Run AI models locally on your computer - free and private.

Models shown are those loaded in LM Studio.
See 'System Check' in Settings for recommendations.

Ollama (Local)._description:
Run AI models locally with Ollama - free, private, and easy to use.

Ollama automatically manages models and runs in the background.
Use Settings → Local AI Setup to download and manage models.

agentaus.description: Australian sovereign AI by Trellis Data. Data and models stay in Australia, protected by defence-grade encryption.
